text: Nobody quit this Steam demo in under ten minutes. Not one reviewer.
The median player had eleven hours in before they wrote anything.
Guildrun is a PvE autobattler roguelike. You draft a team of heroes, then watch the fight resolve itself.
Now the build. It's Unity, and twenty four assembly names leak out of a data file. Here's what they installed.
Sentry for crash reports. SQLite for three hundred relics. Zero-allocation LINQ. That's not a first project's list.
And the negative reviewers had played longer than the positive ones. Fifteen hours.
They didn't bounce. They hit the ceiling. Full teardown on the channel.
